mutants.why: apfsParseDecmpfsHeader must reject any attribute lacking the 'cmpf' magic and accept one that has it; inverting != to == returns nullopt for the valid header and accepts a forged one. apfsCompression_decmpfsHeaderRequiresCmpfSignature asserts QVERIFY(parsed.has_value()) on a good header and QVERIFY(!apfsParseDecmpfsHeader(bad).has_value()) after bad[0]='X'

a decmpfs attribute of exactly kApfsDecmpfsHeaderBytes (16) is the minimal valid header; relaxing < to <= rejects it as too short. apfsCompression_decmpfsHeaderRequiresCmpfSignature builds a 16-byte header via apfsBuildDecmpfsHeader and asserts QVERIFY(parsed.has_value())

the inline-vs-stored branch: a zlib stream begins 0x78 (0x78 & 0x0F == 0x08) and must take the qUncompress path, not the stored path. Inverting the test misroutes the zlib payload into the stored branch, whose length check fails -> nullopt. The reader decodes inline zlib via apfsDecodeInlineDecmpfs -> apfsDecodeInlineZlibPayload; apfsWriter_createOrReplaceWriteHonorsCompression writes a highly-compressible 20000-byte inline-zlib file and asserts QVERIFY2(readBack.ok) and QCOMPARE(readBack.data, first)

apfsLzbitmapDecodeBlock selects the LZBITMAP-stream decode path when the block begins 0x5A; inverting == to != treats a valid ZBM stream as a stored block (low-nibble check then fails) and vice versa. apfsLzbitmapDecodesAppleReferenceStream feeds a 0x5A-led Apple stream and asserts QVERIFY2(decoded.has_value()) and QCOMPARE(*decoded, payload)

a stored on-disk block is a 1-byte 0xFF marker plus expectedBytes of data, so block.size()-1 must equal expectedBytes; dropping the -1 makes the check compare marker+data against expectedBytes and reject every valid stored block -> nullopt. apfsLzbitmapCodecRoundTrips round-trips an incompressible payload that forces 0xFF stored blocks and asserts QVERIFY2(parsed.has_value()) and QCOMPARE(*parsed, payload)

the first block_offs entry must point just past the (blockCount+1)-entry table; seeding the running offset at 0 instead of tableBytes places block 0 at offset 0 and corrupts the whole table. apfsLzbitmapResourceForkLayoutMatchesApfsck asserts QCOMPARE(static_cast<int>(offs), tableBytes) for the i==0 entry

a back-reference copies from period bytes EARLIER in the output; reading out_pos+period copies unwritten (zero) bytes ahead of the cursor and mis-decodes every compressed chunk. apfsLzbitmapDecodesAppleReferenceStream asserts QCOMPARE(*decoded, payload) on Apple's own encoded stream

the per-group 8-bit bitmap selects, for byte i, a fresh literal (bit set) or a back-reference copy (bit clear); testing bit i+1 instead of i flips the literal-vs-copy decision for every output byte and mis-decodes. apfsLzbitmapDecodesAppleReferenceStream asserts QCOMPARE(*decoded, payload)

a full 64 KiB block is two chunks whose decmp_len is exactly kMaxDecmpChunkSize (0x8000, the legal maximum the encoder emits); relaxing > to >= rejects that legal chunk and fails the decode. apfsLzbitmapCodecRoundTrips round-trips exactly-one-block ('Q'*65536) and two-full-block ('Z'*131072) payloads and asserts QVERIFY2(parsed.has_value()) and QCOMPARE(*parsed, payload)
